dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you researching all this?

dialogues.speaker: Ctesiphon
dialogues.text: Hah! See, now you're asking the right questions.

dialogues.speaker: Ctesiphon
dialogues.text: I'm Ctesiphon, a researcher from the Akademiya Vahumana, and I'm currently studying the unique ecosystem of the tea trade in Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Ctesiphon
dialogues.text: I have to say, the reasoning behind the tea farmers, teahouses, the Communications Office, and other organizations' distribution of work is quite ingenious...

dialogues.speaker: Ctesiphon
dialogues.text: To produce crops of the same quality and do so at scale, it's necessary to study the proper division of labor...
